comparator.name: Business Administration
comparator.sourceNotes: The exact target is the Dutch-taught full-time BSc Bedrijfskunde, CROHO50645, distinct from English IBA. Appendix3 of the2026–2027 OER pp33–34 lists ten6ECfirst-year components, ten6ECsecond-year components, three6ECadvanced third-year courses,30ECfree choice and12ECthesis:25components totalling180EC. The renewed degree starts from2024–2025; current B2/B3 page cohorts are compatible, not an inter-cohort credit mixture. However the formal thesis-entry conflict means this numerical180EC structure cannot be certified as a formally valid complete pathway. Other applicable rules are verified independently. September49-page edition supersedes the older July47-page edition for citation; both visibly repeat the thesis conflict. Fresh1November2026 review again verifies the25 published positions/180EC and all supported rules. Official current OER index links the same49-page edition; fresh public2026thesis catalogue still names BIN117B,BPRA171,BPRO100A whereas Appendix4 requires old OIM A/B names. Appendix3 identifies BPRA171 as QuantitativeMethods1 and BPRO100A as SustainableEntrepreneurship, not an explicit equivalence to OIM A/B. No new authority resolves the contradiction. This is source-verification attempt1 in the restart audit, not inherited failure count. All prepared UCR repairs remain internal/provisional; no no-match disposition or completed academic approval.

components.name: Introduction to Behaviour in Organisations and Work
Free-choice space
components.note: 30 EC of free choice in third-year semester 1. University courses, an 18-EC minor plus further courses, study abroad or an internship require approval and non-overlap. OER Article 17 permits 6, 12 or 24-EC internships; no internship or minor is compulsory.

components.name: Bachelor's Thesis in Business Administration
components.note: Clarify the controlling 2026–2027 thesis-entry requirement for the Dutch Bedrijfskunde programme MAN-BPRO372A. The latest September OER Appendix 4 p35 requires at least102 EC including Academic Skills and Onderzoeks- en Interventiemethodologie A and B, which are absent under those names from the renewed Appendix3 curriculum. The current official2026 Osiris course172589 instead requires102 EC including BIN117B, BPRA171 and BPRO100A. An authoritative amendment, explicit equivalence/transition rule or precedence statement is needed to reconcile these current official conditions. No exemption, replacement equivalence or administrative error is assumed.

alternatives.labelRationale: Business functions and research carry the main curricular weight. Four environmental science and technology courses are replaced by qualitative methods, data analysis, AI governance and finance; sustainability is applied to business decisions rather than asserted from environmental coherence alone.
alternatives.distinctnessRationale: The emphasis is responsible business and sustainable products, supported by environmental limits, climate, life-cycle assessment, ethics and policy context.
